text: How should a format represent a field that has no value, and why is the question harder than it looks?
choices: Use the literal text `NULL`, which is the convention every CSV reader understands.
Omit the field entirely, since a reader can detect the missing column by counting.
Use a sentinel such as -1, since it cannot be confused with real data in most fields.
Prefer an empty field, because every alternative — `NULL`, `N/A`, a sentinel number — is a legal value some record might genuinely contain.
explanation: `N/A` is a legal book title and -1 is a legal temperature. It is Chapter 28's sentinel problem arriving in a file format instead of a return value — the same defect for the same reason — and the empty field wins only because it at least cannot be confused with something a person typed. Whatever you choose, write it down.
